title: Voice-over track
judge_notes: For the layer gate, audio/vo.wav is the placed voice-over for the whole film: the synthetic voice saying lines[].tts at lines[].at. A single take or audition is judged with the same questions, against its own line. Captions use lines[].text.

questions.text: Is audio/vo.wav present and not empty?
Does the voice track last the film's duration?
Is every voice-over line placed on the timeline?
Does every line end inside its shot?
For Hindi and Hinglish, is the text sent to the voice in Devanagari?
Does the voice say the words of its line or lines exactly, in order, with nothing added or dropped?
questions.evidence: Name any word added, dropped or changed.

questions.text: Is the brand or product name said clearly and correctly?
Does it sound like a natural person in the voice style screenplay.json gives, not robotic and not an announcer?
Does each line land inside its at-to-end time?
questions.evidence: Name any line that runs late.

questions.text: Are the spoken fillers said naturally, not read out flatly?
questions.evidence: Name one filler and how it sounds.

questions.text: Is the pronunciation right for the language (Hindi words in a native accent for Hindi and Hinglish)?
Is the recording clean: no clicks, cut-off or doubled words, no noise or music under it?
questions.evidence: Name the second of any fault.

questions.text: Is the pace easy to follow, with small natural pauses between lines?
